title: Court Cost Funding Terms — Legal Forwarding Agreements
content:
Under the Legal Forwarding Agreements, each forwarding programme fixes four terms on the funding of court and service costs: whether Ridgeline advances court costs itself, the largest total of costs it advances on one matter, the single cost above which the creditor client's approval is needed before it is paid, and the calendar days after a cost invoice within which the client must reimburse costs the deposit did not cover.

## Funding terms by programme

| Programme | Ridgeline advances court costs | Advance cap per matter | Single-cost approval threshold | Cost invoice due |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | No | $0.00 | $0.00 | 0 days |
| Small Claims Suit Program | No | $0.00 | $150.00 | 15 days |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | No | $0.00 | $500.00 | 15 days |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Yes | $750.00 | $300.00 | 30 days |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | No | $0.00 | $250.00 | 15 days |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | No | $0.00 | $1000.00 | 30 days |

## Meaning of each term

- **Ridgeline advances court costs.** Whether Ridgeline advances court costs itself. Only the Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program shows Yes.
- **Advance cap per matter.** The largest total of costs Ridgeline advances on one matter, in USD; $0.00 where it advances none. The Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program's cap is $750.00 per matter; it is a total across all the costs of the matter, not a limit on each cost.
- **Single-cost approval threshold.** The single cost above which the client's approval is needed before it is paid, in USD; $0.00 where no costs are paid. The Attorney Demand Program pays no costs and so shows $0.00.
- **Cost invoice due.** The calendar days after a cost invoice within which the client must reimburse costs the deposit did not cover.

## Threshold readings on hypothetical costs

The threshold is measured against one cost at a time, and "above" is strictly greater than the figure.

| Programme | Hypothetical single cost | Above the threshold? |
|---|---|---|
| Small Claims Suit Program | $150.00 | No — equal to $150.00 |
| Small Claims Suit Program | $150.01 | Yes |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | $260.00 | Yes — above $250.00 |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | $300.00 | No — equal to $300.00 |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | $980.00 | No — below $1000.00 |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | $520.00 | Yes — above $500.00 |

## Cap reading on hypothetical costs

Under the Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program, suppose a matter has already had $600.00 of costs advanced by Ridgeline and a further $200.00 cost arises. The cap of $750.00 is a total for the matter: $150.00 of room remains under it, and the remaining $50.00 of the new cost lies above the cap.

The costs above are invented figures used only to show how the terms read.
